content:
Grouping follows the technical and ordering tables: four orderable SKUs (LRA–LRD) each map to one nominal center and min/max transmit range; shared 100GBASE-LR / 100GbE, 50 Gbaud PAM4, 103.12 Gbps aggregate, KP4 FEC, and 4×25.78 Gbps electrical lanes. `SO-QSFP28-100G-LRx` is the family title only—not a fifth wavelength variant—so it is not a separate mode. No penalties were supplied.
